title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode11 The Four of Us

meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa! You guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Where are we...? Aboard a ship...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were just doing a show at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
You guys all dreamt about doing a show?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Dream? What are you talking about...?
We were really just doing a show, and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't understand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all became enveloped in that light and suddenly fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. After that, we decided to carry you all here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
Hmmm... Now my head's spinning!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Mine too... But we somehow managed to get back...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it would seem so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, even if we did fall asleep, I doubt that was any ordinary dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It felt so real.
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Y-Y-You guys!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We have super big news!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Rin...?! Len...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are all awake!
Thank goodness... We were so worried!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Still, you two seem very anxious.
What was this about big news...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That tree grew really big all of a sudden!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The tree...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What in the world happened?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When we saw it earlier, it was a lot smaller... How is this even possible...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's so big...!
Bigger than you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: It has grown at a tremendous pace.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Rui, you guys all fell asleep after you touched the black stuff on the tree.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: After that happened, we started inspecting every inch of it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we wanted to see if we could find a way to wake you guys back up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, all the black things suddenly started to glow bright white...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was so bright that we ended up closing our eyes, but once we could open them back up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It had grown this big, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that still doesn't explain anything!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But all the black fragments are gone.
Does that mean it's all better now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I don't know if this is the case...
But what if the tree used those fragments to grow to this size?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You mean it used those awful-looking things...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, MEIKO said that those flecks resembled fragments of feelings... But they weren't exactly the same because they were all black...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, did they make you guys have that dream...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's certainly a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, what was your dream about exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. We hadn't fully described what happened yet. As for me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, you all dreamed about your troupe becoming separated...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. We'd chosen to go our separate ways and pursue our dreams on our own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And for some strange reason, we couldn't really remember anything about SEKAI or any of you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But why did it make you have that kind of dream...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have no proof of this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But those fragments may've shown you that dream because of the feelings that lingered within all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Feelings that lingered within all of us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The fear that you'd become separated and never see each other again. You've all considered the possibility before, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As we all know, that never came to pass. But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It doesn't seem too farfetched to think that all the doubts, worries and pain you'd been harboring managed to manifest in SEKAI right at that moment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I have a feeling that you saw that dream because you had those feelings lingering inside of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, it took all those feelings and showed us a world of “What if?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I thought this was Tsukasa's SEKAI.
Why were we able to see that dream?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's a simple answer to that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, this is indeed Tsukasa's SEKAI, but you and the others can come and go as you please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, it certainly wouldn't surprise me to hear that your feelings are also able to affect this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Does it really work like that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Again, these are just possibilities.
But the fact is that the stronger your feelings are, the greater the impact you'll have on SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I think I understand now.
In layman's terms...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The pain and conflict we endured long ago has come back to help us grow! Does that sound right...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! How did you arrive on that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I thought that was the obvious conclusion from the start.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Think about it.
Our tree here grew to this tremendous size after absorbing all those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And from the sound of things, those fragments seem to have represented all of our worst doubts and fears. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to overcome that pain and suffering. No, not just overcome it. We need to turn it into nutrients for growth...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmmm... I sorta get what you're trying to say, but also don't...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe...☆
But it's a super duper great expression of who you are, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's got this bang-boom-zippity-zoom feel to it☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I'll take that as a compliment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Honestly, you guys are way too positive...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That being said...
I did learn a few things from that dream.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You learned a few things?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though I kept pursuing my dream after we went our separate ways... A lot of things didn't go too well for me on my own.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I realize now just how incredibly important it was for me to stay with you guys and grow together as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I honestly felt a little relieved when I realized that it was all just a dream...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As interesting a dream as it was.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
When I woke up and saw you guys next to me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I started tearing up a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Our dreams mean everything to us.
That will never change.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's nice to have your friends by your side while you're chasing after them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because we make each other stronger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was reminded of just how precious the time we get to spend putting on shows together is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I learned that there are certain lessons and experiences we can only have together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, let's keep doing everything we can together☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll keep watching over all of you as you try to make your dreams a reality... We'll always be here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we greatly appreciate your support!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, wanna head back and start practicing for that show?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right... I totally forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That dream did sort of make us lose track of time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
Even though we're all back, I still don't feel like I've fully returned...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, why don't we do something to refocus our attention on the task at hand?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like our usual chant. It feels like it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that seems like a nice idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Woohoo☆
Then, we'll join you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! With big smiles☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Emu!
You have the honors! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Let's keep trying really hard and doing everything we can together☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready?!
Won-Won-Won-Won...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!
